statement:
∀ bar : Reduction.loc p →+* K,
 letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra
 ∀ (s : Reduction.loc p) (c : K), s • c = bar s * c
proof:
intro bar
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra
intro s c
rfl
